summary: Tested three new Langa Scorpions features (sponsor wall, object-storage image uploads, live Stripe checkout). All 11 backend pytest cases passed. Full frontend flow verified: home sponsor wall renders, admin sponsors CMS CRUD works end-to-end via UI, gallery uploader posts to /api/admin/upload and populates full backend-prefixed /api/files/... URL (stories & sponsors logo uploaders also present with correct testids), donate pay-by-card without name/email shows toast then with details redirects to https://checkout.stripe.com, /donate/success?session_id=fake_id renders data-testid='donate-success' without crashing. Regression: pledge POST /api/public/donations still returns {status:pledged}; public home endpoints (settings, stories, impact, sponsors) all 200.

ui_bugs.issue: Row primary label used `row.title || row.caption || row.image_url` — sponsor documents have `name`, so /admin/sponsors list rendered visually blank rows (Edit/Delete visible but no name/tier). FIXED by including row.name/row.tier/row.website in the fallback chain.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py public_sponsors sorts by created_at asc only; consider tier-priority ordering for the wall (currently frontend groups client-side which works).
CmsPage row template mixes many resource fields into one fallback chain — brittle; consider a per-CmsPage `renderRow` callback for clarity. Sponsors bug was a symptom of this pattern.
server.py is ~790 lines and mixes auth, CRUD, storage proxy, and Stripe — approaching the 700-line split guideline; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, admin, public, storage, payments).
donation_status reconciles Stripe on every non-paid poll (unauthenticated endpoint) — acceptable for MVP but could be abused; add rate-limiting or session-ownership check later.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests against wildcard; in production set explicit origins.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 6 sponsors on startup (Cape Town Community Trust, Rainbow Foundation, Ubuntu Grants, Langa Local FC, Table Mountain Motors, Southern Sun Sports). All test-created TEST_* sponsors were deleted at end of tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_2 verified all three new features end-to-end. One minor display bug in AdminPages.jsx CmsPage row rendering was fixed inline (sponsor name/tier now appears in list). Stripe checkout uses Flow B with sk_test_emergent and correctly redirects to checkout.stripe.com. Object storage upload returns {storage_path, url} where url starts with /api/files/... and frontend ImageUploader prefixes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Poll endpoint /api/public/donations/status/{sid} reconciles paid sessions into donations collection.
rca of the issue: Bug: /admin/sponsors list rows appeared blank. RCA: CmsPage in AdminPages.jsx uses a shared fallback expression `row.title || row.caption || row.image_url` for the row primary label. Sponsor documents have no title/caption/image_url — the primary field is `name`. So all sponsor rows rendered empty strings. Reproduction: log in as admin -> /admin/sponsors -> list shows 8 rows with Edit/Delete but no visible name. Mitigation applied: extended the fallback chain to include row.name (and secondary line now includes row.tier/row.website). Verified fix by re-rendering after refresh — 'Cape Town Community Trust / headline' now renders correctly.
